reelection.rule: Rule: next even-year November for this House term. legislators-current.yaml ends the current term on 2027-01-03. The even-year November before that January 3 end is November 2026. The file has no election day, so no day of the month is shown.

posts.text:
I’m proud to join Reps. Khanna, Landsman, and Fitzpatrick in reintroducing the Campus Accountability and Safety Act.  

This bill will help combat sexual abuse on college campuses by strengthening how colleges and universities prevent, report, and respond to sexual abuse.

Students can’t learn if they are not safe. No student should have to fear sexual harassment, violence, or stalking while pursuing an education.

Palm Beach County! Early voting starts today and runs through November 1. Polls are open from 7:00 A.M. to 7:00 P.M.   

To find a polling site near you, visit https://t.co/wJg3i5Wgh6. https://t.co/3eFDouOEJA

Our families shouldn’t have to bear the burden of constant aircraft noise and disruption. While I’m glad the FAA did not make the Mar-a-Lago flight restrictions permanent, the FAA must do more to protect our neighborhoods. With more than 21,000 residents affected, I’ll keep working with local leaders, the FAA, and airport officials to reduce disruption and find better solutions.

This week, the @PeaceCorps celebrates reaching 250,000 volunteers!   

Since 1961, the Peace Corps has trained and deployed volunteers across 144 countries to promote peace, cultural exchange, and development. This is American soft power at its finest – congratulations to the Peace Corps!

The Trump Administration’s threats to cut off internet access and limit intelligence sharing with Ukraine fuels Putin’s war of aggression. 

These threats are serious, we can’t look away when Elon Musk and Trump embolden Russia’s brutality and open the floodgates to more suffering. 

https://t.co/LB7dukxcKY

I am heartbroken by the horrible shooting at an elementary school in Bend, Oregon. My thoughts are with the victims and their families. 

Elementary school students should be focused on learning and not finding a place to hide from a shooter. We must continue to support common sense gun safety legislation that will protect our children.

I’m appalled by reports of an attempted shooting at a Hindu temple near Chicago. Everyone deserves to feel safe wherever they gather to pray. 

I’m thinking of @CongressmanRaja, his family, and the community during this difficult time. https://t.co/ljt7ntUNqs

Medicare Open Enrollment starts today! 

From now until December 7, if you are 65+ you can make changes to your health coverage, medication plan, and more. 

For more information about your options, visit https://t.co/Nvk3eaGvRK or reach out to your local agency on aging for accurate, impartial guidance.

If you need help with Social Security or VA benefits, Passports, Immigration services, the IRS, or other federal agencies, call my office at (561)-998-9045. 

We are always happy to assist you in getting the information you need or a problem resolved. https://t.co/TQX6z8JscK

The 340B program helps safety-net hospitals and community health centers stretch limited resources to serve more patients. We should be making it easier for these providers to deliver affordable care—not adding costly new requirements. 

That’s why I’m co-leading the 340B Rebate Model Delay Act with @RepBresnahan, @RepDebDingell, & @RepMann to block this new rebate policy before it takes effect.

Last month, the NSRP Appropriations Subcommittee held a hearing with the leaders of our international trade and investment agencies. Bipartisan support for these critical soft power tools strengthens American economic and strategic interests around the world. https://t.co/fcYjGwv8LA

October is Breast Cancer Awareness Month. 1 in 8 women will be diagnosed with breast cancer during her lifetime. 

This month, we lift up survivors and their loved ones who are navigating this life-changing diagnosis. 

Early detection saves lives. Find a screening program near you at https://t.co/zhKvG9f8S8

President Trump’s bigoted and shortsighted decision to provide almost all refugee resettlement slots to white South Africans casts aside thousands of people still waiting in line - individuals and families who fled persecution, are already vetted, and deserve to start a new life here in the United States.  

We must continue to support those seeking refuge in our country, and give them a fair shot at a fresh start.

https://t.co/N4IpGMSGPD

To find a provider near you, visit https://t.co/8Vwk7uXNwG https://t.co/aidIlJ21sX

This week, I met with leaders from BAPS to discuss protecting houses of worship and keeping our communities safe. 

No one should ever fear violence because of where or how they worship. I’ll keep working to ensure faith-based communities have the resources they need to stay secure.

¡Feliz Mes Nacional de la Herencia Hispana! Este mes, celebramos a las generaciones de hispanoamericanos cuya cultura, trabajo arduo y liderazgo han ayudado a formar nuestras comunidades y nuestro país.  

Estoy orgullosa de poder celebrar junto a nuestros vecinos hispanos en todo el sur de la Florida.

Happy Hispanic Heritage Month! This month, we celebrate the generations of Hispanic Americans whose culture, hard work, and leadership have helped shape our communities and our country. 

I’m proud to celebrate with our Hispanic neighbors across South Florida. https://t.co/DLSJ0WtWHM

Proud to celebrate the opening of the new Aid to Victims of Domestic Abuse center in Palm Beach County. 

I was glad to secure $1 million in federal funding to help make this project possible. This new space means more room, resources, and support for survivors to build safe, independent lives.

Congratulations to Fatima Ezzahra El Mansouri, Morocco’s first female Prime Minister! 

This is a historic, exciting moment for Morocco and a win for women’s political participation in a region where their voices are essential to peace and security. 

https://t.co/TE4tFMTo51

Today is Latina Equal Pay Day. Latinas earn just 53 cents for every dollar earned by white, non-Hispanic men—costing them more than $33,000 a year. 

That gap means less money for rent, groceries, child care, and saving for the future. I’ll keep fighting to raise wages and close the gap.

Last week, I submitted formal comments opposing the FAA’s proposal to make the Mar-a-Lago flight restrictions permanent. 

Presidential security is essential—but so is minimizing the burden on our community. I’ll keep fighting for an approach that does both. https://t.co/TjNyYW6YFQ

Florida ranks second nationwide with nearly 3,200 banned books last school year. These stories have the power to teach valuable lessons, shape minds, and change perspectives. 

This Banned Books Week, we celebrate the freedom to read and protect our stories from those who are trying to censor schools and libraries.

On October 7, 2023, Hamas and its accomplices stormed Israel, brutally murdered more than 1,200 people, committed horrific acts of sexual violence, and abducted 251 hostages, including Americans and citizens of more than 40 countries. 

On this solemn anniversary, we honor the lives of those lost and the bravery of the hostages and their families, and recommit ourselves to a better future - where Israel is safe and secure and everyone in the region can live in peace and dignity.
Proud to join this effort. https://t.co/JCnBoHFpZI

I’m pleased that @NoFallenHeroes has been awarded $750,000 in federal funding to support South Florida communities, including right here in Palm Beach County. 

This investment will expand access to critical mental health and suicide prevention resources for Veterans who are not connected to VA care.
Honored to be with FL @ActiveRetirees (FLARA) today in West Palm Beach. We will never stop fighting to protect Social Security and Medicare. https://t.co/KWffm058LL

The Trump Administration redirected $20 million in federal funding to help pay for political ads. That is an unacceptable use of taxpayer money. 

The Trump Administration should be prioritizing the affordability crisis, not pushing a political agenda. https://t.co/0QUbsUekYU
